I do not care which one. I would like, in whatever arrangement you make between you, for there to be a room in it for me, named in the document, with a key that is mine and not loaned to me, for as long as I want it. In exchange for that, I will assign my third to whichever of you keeps the house, for one dollar. I have spoken to no lawyer. I am speaking now. I will speak again if you tell me I am wrong to speak.\"

There was a silence.

It was, Asha thought, the largest silence she had heard in this house, and the largest silence she had heard in any house in many years. It had a quality of attention in it that was almost physical, as if the silence itself were leaning forward to listen.

Lucia spoke first.

\"Rosa.\"

\"Yes.\"

\"You cannot do that.\"

\"I am doing it.\"

\"Rosa.\"

\"Lucia. Listen to me. I am sixty-eight years old. I have a sister in Camden and three nieces and a savings account that is larger than your brother thinks it is and smaller than your sister thinks it is. I do not need a building. I need a room.
